wins.text: Q1 revenue of $634M, up 21% YoY, exceeding the high end of prior guidance; sixth consecutive quarter of GAAP profitability with record GAAP net income of $106M
U.S. commercial revenue grew 40% YoY and 14% QoQ to $150M; excluding strategic contracts, grew 68% YoY and 22% QoQ — surpassing international commercial revenue for the first time
Adjusted operating margin expanded to 36%, Rule of 40 Score hit 57 (up 3 points sequentially), marking the sixth consecutive quarter of expanding adjusted operating margins
Commercial TCV booked was $505M, up 187% YoY; U.S. commercial TCV booked was $286M, up 131% YoY; U.S. commercial customer count grew 69% YoY and 19% QoQ to 262 customers
Awarded $178M sole-prime contract by U.S. Army for next-generation TITAN targeting node — first time a software company has won a prime contract for a hardware system

risks.text: International commercial revenue declined 3% sequentially to $149M due to continued headwinds in Europe; CEO acknowledged Europe is 'gliding towards 0% GDP growth' with no easy remedy
Revenue from strategic commercial contracts expected to decline sharply to $7M–$9M in Q2 2024 vs. $19M in Q2 2023, creating a near-term revenue headwind
International government revenue declined 9% sequentially to $79M due to Q4 revenue catch-up and continued European headwinds
Management acknowledged the U.S. commercial sales motion is still early and imperfect — 'we have not cracked the sales motion' — suggesting execution risk as the company scales
Scalability constraint: limited number of Palantir software engineers constrains ability to serve a rapidly growing customer base; company is relying on customers to self-serve via AIP platform

guidance_items.detail: Full year 2024 revenue raised to $2.677B–$2.689B; Q2 2024 revenue guided to $649M–$653M
U.S. commercial revenue guidance raised to in excess of $661M, representing at least 45% growth
Full year adjusted income from operations raised to $868M–$880M; Q2 adjusted income from operations guided to $209M–$213M
Adjusted free cash flow of $800M–$1B unchanged; GAAP operating income and net income expected in each quarter of 2024

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Boot camp conversion rates and deal cycle specifics — management did not proactively quantify conversion metrics in prepared remarks
Scaling/implementation capacity — how Palantir handles surging demand with a limited headcount of engineers was not addressed proactively
Geopolitical stance and its reception among customers — management's outspoken positions on Israel, Ukraine, and domestic politics were not addressed in prepared remarks
